read_rule: Only the listed exact files, own scope and own created files. No folder listings or scope expansion; ask Root for missing exact definitions.

deliverable: Fresh own plan and referenced API reading before edits; close only assigned fourth-run evidence; own static self-review. Report files read, modified, created, key changes, decisions, preserved compatibility, exact unresolved dependencies; then stop.
acceptance: The same single Root-owned complete remote RV1 suite only. No independent tests or local workload.
connected_surface_reason: Only additional admitted-legacy observation in the same existing stage; product protocol, admission and capability sources are forbidden.
diagnostics_rule: Only owned mixed-version subdirectory daemon logs and CLI operation/lifecycle artifacts. No token, credential, private identity/profile or lock-secret reads; discover exact subdirectory from existing mixed-version log.
